review_evidence: README identifies mdgen as a tool that converts `.lean` files into Markdown and documents converter/CLI behavior.
All 17 primary Lean files were reviewed by role: Mdgen/* implements string/file/comment conversion and CLI behavior; Test.lean is an output comparator; Test/Src files are formatter/exercise fixtures.

Declaration scan found no theorem/lemma/axiom declarations. The only `example`s are six elementary propositional/arithmetic fixtures in Test/Src/Exercise.lean plus toy declarations embedded in the raw-conversion fixture.

source_action.content_invariant: The complete 17-primary-file snapshot consists of Markdown conversion/CLI/file utilities and regression fixtures. It contains no theorem/lemma/axiom declarations; the few `example`s and toy definitions are deliberately input fixtures for the converter, so retirement removes tooling/test vocabulary without hiding an independent formal development.
evidence: README explicitly describes `.lean` to `.md` generation and points readers to Test/Src/Raw/First.lean as converter test input.
Complete declaration-class scan found no theorem/lemma/axiom declarations; six simple examples occur in Test/Src/Exercise.lean and toy declarations occur in the raw-format fixture.
Mdgen/ConvertToMd.lean implements conversion and embeds #eval regression cases; Test.lean compares generated files against expected Markdown.
source_action.rationale: mdgen is a documentation-generation application and regression-fixture repository, not an independently addressable mathematical formalization or formal specification.

summary: Reviewed mdgen and retire it as a Markdown-generation application whose formal-looking test snippets are converter fixtures, not an independent mathematics/specification corpus.
